candidate.proposed_mechanism: Utilizing a Multivariate Hawkes Point Process to model self-exciting event arrival intensities based on M5 bar return exceedances.
candidate.analogical_source: Hawkes Point Process from point process theory, which is used to model events that exhibit clustering behavior.
candidate.claim: The self-exciting nature of the Multivariate Hawkes Point Process allows for the identification of endogenous cascade risks in USDJPY, leading to profitable trading opportunities during periods of heightened volatility.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Literature indicates that the Hawkes process effectively captures the clustering of financial events, particularly in high-frequency trading environments (see: Bacry et al., 2015). The ability to estimate arrival intensities can provide insights into potential price movements following significant return exceedances.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: If the strategy fails to achieve a Sharpe ratio greater than 1.0 over a backtest period of 6 months, the hypothesis is disproven.

backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Calculate absolute returns and rolling standard deviation to identify exceedance events (abs(return_t) > 2.0 * rolling_std).

backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit the position at the next bar open O_{t+1} after entry.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Implement a stop-loss at 1.5 times the average true range (ATR) of the last 10 bars.
backtest_spec.benchmark_baseline: Compare against a simple buy-and-hold strategy on USDJPY over the same period.
